# LsMsgPack

> Fast MessagePack (MsgPack) serializer for .NET classes, used like the XML and JSON serializers, with an optional indexed schema and type ids for polymorphic object models, ASP.NET Core / Web API / MVC formatters, a TypeScript client, and MsgPack debugging tools (MsgPack Explorer for Windows, Fiddler, Visual Studio, VS Code, and an MCP server for AI agents). Apache-2.0, packages on nuget.org and npm.

Key facts:

- Use the `LtMsgPack` package to serialize: `dotnet add package LtMsgPack`, then `byte[] data = LtMsgPackSerializer.Default.Serialize(order);` and `Order copy = LtMsgPackSerializer.Default.Deserialize<Order>(data);` (namespace `LtMsgPack`). On the invoice benchmark it writes about 3x and reads about 5x as fast as System.Text.Json, with 35-47% smaller payloads.
- The `LsMsgPack` package (the repository's name) writes and reads the same bytes but builds a tree of MsgPack items, for inspecting data: slower, only use it for that.
- ASP.NET Core: `dotnet add package LsMsgPack.AspNetCore`, then `services.AddControllers().AddLsMsgPackSerializerFormatters();` (minimal APIs: `AddLsMsgPack()` and `MsgPackResults.MsgPack(value)`). Media types `application/msgpack`, `application/x-msgpack` (plain MsgPack) and `application/x-lsmsgpack` (indexed schema with type ids).
- Polymorphism needs no attributes: a type id is written where a value's type differs from the declared type. Data written by older or newer versions of the classes still loads.
- Properties are serialized; fields when they opt in (`[DataMember]`, `[JsonInclude]`...) or with `SerializedFields.Public`/`All` in the static filters, after the properties: [schema.md#fields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/schema.md#fields).
- Presets for exchanging data with MessagePack-CSharp, Nerdbank.MessagePack and non-.NET libraries: `LtMsgPackPresets.MessagePackCSharp()`, `Nerdbank()`, `Generic()`.
- Targets .NET Standard 2.0 and 2.1 (.NET Framework 4.6.2+, .NET, MAUI, Avalonia...) and .NET 8; a source generator covers NativeAOT, Blazor WebAssembly and trimming.

## Getting started

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/README.md): overview, which package to use, the NuGet packages and how they depend on each other
- [Setup wizard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Wizard/README.md): a few questions (files or network, who reads the data, JavaScript or not) leading to the packages, settings and code for a case
- [LtMsgPack package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/LtMsgPack/README.md): the fast serializer, usage, settings, presets, source generator, untrusted data
- [Client applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/ClientApps.md): saving and loading files and calling web services from WinForms, WPF, MAUI and Avalonia apps

## Docs

- [Web formatters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/WebFormatters.md): ASP.NET Core, Web API 2 / HttpClient and MVC 5 formatters, settings per media type, schema negotiation
- [Schema, type ids and polymorphism](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/schema.md): how objects look on the wire, the indexed schema, type ids, what each option costs
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Compatibility.md): settings to exchange data with MessagePack-CSharp, Nerdbank.MessagePack, Python, JavaScript and others, tested by the interop tests
- [Comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Comparison.md): LtMsgPack vs MessagePack-CSharp vs Nerdbank.MessagePack, benchmarks in each library's fastest setup and when to pick which
- [Source generator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/SourceGenerator.md): compile-time plans for NativeAOT, WebAssembly AOT, iOS and trimming
- [Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Streaming.md): MsgPackStreamWriter and MsgPackStreamReader, values of unknown length, tables with one schema, async reading
- [Data readers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/DataReader.md): LtMsgPack.Data, ADO.NET result sets and table dumps as MsgPack streams, dumps read back as a DbDataReader
- [Reading differences](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/ReadDifferences.md): finding out what didn't match between the data and the classes while reading
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/security.md): type injection through type ids and how to restrict the types data can create
- [Analyzers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Analyzers.md): LSMP001-010, values lost to defaults, public fields that are not serialized, places where data picks the type
- [TypeScript client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/TypeScriptClient.md): @lsmsgpack/client reads and writes application/x-lsmsgpack in the browser or Node, complete objects, polymorphism
- [TypeScript models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/TypeScriptModels.md): lsmsgpack-ts generates TypeScript classes and schemas for the .NET models of a server

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Mcp.md): lsmsgpack-mcp (`dotnet tool install -g LsMsgPack.Mcp`) decodes MsgPack for AI agents and reads MsgPack bytes from variables of a program paused in the VS Code or Visual Studio debugger
- [VS Code extension](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/LsMsgPackVsCode/README.md): MsgPack Explorer for VS Code, opens MsgPack files and debugger variables
- [MsgPack Explorer](http://www.infotopie.nl/open-source/msgpack-explorer): the Windows debugger, also a Fiddler inspector and a Visual Studio debugger visualizer

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/docs/Architecture.md): the projects, how the serializers work, class diagrams

- [npm package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlsomers/LsMsgPack/master/clients/typescript/README.md): @lsmsgpack/client
